Darwin callbacks execute in ordinary thread context through serialized thread_call objects, rather than Linux hrtimer hard interrupt context.
A failed synchronous cancellation quarantines and retains ownership; it is never reported as clean teardown.
device_state: real nv_state_t rc_timer_enabled, no duplicated layout
native_callback_tests: explicit typed RM callback fixture; does not establish actual RM callback or GPU behavior
ownership: failed synchronous cancellation retains timer, callback data and device binding; Unbind refuses quarantine
stack: separate tracked heap nvidia_stack_t plus 15 alignment bytes for each callback; explicit 16-byte alignment; size=sizeof(stack member), top=end; original allocation base freed
